entities.summary: Jerome Johnson Richardson Sr. was an American businessman, professional football player, and owner in the National Football League (NFL). A native of Spring Hope, North Carolina, he played college football for the Wofford Terriers and was twice a Little All-America selection. After graduating, he played two seasons in the NFL with the Baltimore Colts, catching a touchdown pass from John Unitas in the championship game.
